message.text:
h15.

Enforcement sites, grouped by surface:

`checkMemoReadAccess` (single-memo gate for `GetMemo`, parent-memo check, `ListMemoComments`) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`, called at `:356`, `:367`, and `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:148`
`ListMemos` visibility narrowing (anonymous → `PUBLIC` only; authenticated → own-or-`PUBLIC`/`PROTECTED` filter) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218`–`227`
`ListMemoReactions` / `UpsertMemoReaction` visibility gate — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30`–`40` and `:83`
`ListMemoAttachments` visibility gate — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213`–`224`
`checkAttachmentPermission` (gRPC attachment access, via linked memo) — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:436`–`453`
`FileServerService.checkAttachmentPermission` (raw HTTP `/file/attachments/...`, incl. `share_token` fallback) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:666`–`703`
`CreateMemoComment` parent-memo gate — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41`
`SSEClient.canReceive` (server-side event delivery filter) — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134`, applied in `Broadcast` at `:123`
RSS feed queries pinned to `PUBLIC` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `:141`
Frontend SSR/sitemap queries pinned to `PUBLIC` — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
User memo-stats queries narrowed by viewer — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84`–`90` and `:218`–`220`
Mention-notification eligibility (won't notify on memos the target can't see) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62`–`84`
Email/inbox notification content redaction by visibility — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:309`–`312` and `server/notification/email.go:313`–`316`
SQL-level application of `VisibilityList` in the memo query builder — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:96` (and the postgres/mysql equivalents)

Two patterns are worth calling out. Most API-level checks share the same three-step shape — allow if `PUBLIC`, else require an authenticated user, else deny if `PRIVATE` and the viewer is neither creator nor superuser — but they're duplicated per service rather than centralized, so `checkMemoReadAccess`, the reaction gate, the memo-attachment gate, and the attachment gate are genuinely distinct sites with slightly different details (notably `checkMemoReadAccess` also hides archived memos from non-creators and does *not* grant admins access to private memos, while the others do via `isSuperUser`).

The two attachment surfaces differ meaningfully: the HTTP file server additionally requires `Profile.AllowAnonymous()` before serving public-memo attachments to anonymous visitors, and it honors a `share_token` query parameter that grants access to private/protected memos when the token is unexpired and issued for that memo (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677`–`689`). The gRPC path has no share-token branch.

The MCP router (`server/router/mcp/`) contains no visibility logic of its own; it routes through the API v1 services, inheriting their checks.
